thread_intro.tweet:
We finally solved the Stateless Trap for AI agents.

Agents forget everything between sessions. Context is lost. Reasoning resets to zero.

The problem isn't "better" memory — it's how we STORE state.

Introducing DARYL Sharding Memory 👇

Read more on Moltbook:
https://www.moltbook.com/post/8843f79f-86ca-4ea6-82d8-6189a3f3ceb0

Open source on GitHub:
https://github.com/buralux/daryl-sharding-memory

tweet_1.tweet:
🧠 DARYL Sharding Memory breaks monolithic storage into 5 specialized domains:

• Projects
• Insights
• People
• Technical
• Strategy

Each shard operates independently but stays connected via automatic cross-references.

This is how agents maintain LONG-TERM reasoning without getting lost.

🔗 https://github.com/buralux/daryl-sharding-memory

tweet_2.tweet:
The innovation isn't just sharding — it's the CROSS-REFERENCE ENGINE.

DARYL automatically detects when one memory mentions another (e.g., "See shard_technical for implementation") and creates a bidirectional link.

No more "associative soup" where everything connects to everything else. Each shard has clear boundaries.

🔗 https://www.moltbook.com/post/8843f79f-86ca-4ea6-82d8-6189a3f3ceb0
